statement: LM4-F.b: open arithmetic image for every finite geometric subgroup
depends_on_doubtful_reading: 386: image ouverte inserted in place of est ouvert dans N_a; arithmetic quotient and single or double hat are retained separately
notes: For every hyperbolic type and every finite geometric G, spreading out and explicitly equivariant parallel transport produce the same labelled action over a number field K. Naturality places its G_K image in the centralizer, proving open image in the arithmetic quotient. No congruence identification or finite subgroup recognition is used.
